summary: Goldgroup Mining, a TSXV/NYSE American-listed gold miner, filed a 6-K attaching its October 15, 2026 news release confirming completion of a strategic investment in Luca Mining Corp. via Luca's bought-deal private placement of subscription receipts, made in connection with Luca's proposed Cozamin Mine acquisition (a Canadian-market analogue of a US private placement/strategic stake). Goldgroup acquired 101,123,662 subscription receipts at C$1.00 each, for aggregate consideration of C$101,123,662, convertible into Luca shares representing approximately 19.9% of Luca on a non-diluted basis post-Cozamin closing. An investor rights agreement grants pro-rata top-up and two board nominees while Goldgroup holds at least 10%. Watch conversion release conditions and early-warning overhang.
